statement: Building cejel's plain first page (goal_cejel_four_question_summary_2026-11-02), the first draft said "1 file was held back" on a scan whose certificate, a few lines below, said "12 content entries were withheld". The draft had counted only the withheld files some check would have read, a filtered subset, and printed it under the same noun. Every test passed, because no test compared the two numbers; the mismatch showed only when the output was read on a real repository. Rules: when a summary restates a count the artifact below it already prints, compute it from the same population; when the summary needs a subset, print both numbers and name the filter. Read a summary's output on a real input before calling it done; synthetic fixtures rarely carry the populations that diverge.
